lastCompletedStory.title: Wire observe drainer into the sidecar idle-tick (off byte-identical)

nextStoryContext: US-004 added runMetaLoopObserveFn to RunSidecarLoopOptions and wired it in the active!==true idle branch of runSidecarLoop, gated on hasPendingStories() to prevent observe during an in-flight PRD cycle. The production factory makeProductionMetaLoopObserveFn in sidecar.ts calls selectPlannableFromFile (MAIN backlog) + observeDecide + logEvent when meta_loop=observe; undefined when off. makeProductionEscalateFn was extracted to keep buildSidecarLoopDeps under biome complexity limit. US-005 (Notify-on-drain via Resend) should build on the meta-loop-observe event emitted by this story.
